retro:
# Retrospective, PR #12867 follow-up

What worked: neutral public claim/author packet, exact original/current pins, bounded complete policy reads, team-owned fresh sessions, and source-only Sol analysis separated from Opus's isolated experiments. Both independent finals were saved before either was read. A small before/current assertion table explains the result without repeating the original rendering review.

Avoidable friction: Opus attempted two unused plans with node declared as a system requirement although it was available only through a copied fixture binary. Its host ast.parse syntax check violated the runtime-isolation rule despite executing no PR code. All failed/invalid history is retained. Source analysis was already sufficient, so no further fixture was added merely to repair a broad validation total.

Coordinator evidence audit corrected claims of complete guards. The fixture omitted abort-path checks, a chmod readback, independent upstream pipeline producer receipts, possible heredoc final-target assertions, and prior archive-member inventory. Host setup had parent-only assertions for some outputs/Git internals. Narrow raw assertion outcomes remain supported by inspected variants and independent source reasoning; broad totals and blanket compliance claims are excluded. Full details: reviewers/fable/final.md and audit-addendum.md. Sol's metadata array-shape parser failures were read-only intake issues, not tests, and were not used as complete scans.

Remediation for future assignments: keep syntax parsing inside review.py too; avoid unnecessary chmod when invoking bash directly; explicitly guard failure-report paths; audit every transitive shell helper, retaining each producer's status, and inventory archives before extraction. Do not confuse a final marker or output file-set match with implemented gates. Copy provenance checks are not test execution. No shared workflow file was changed from this assignment; this local retrospective carries the requested corrections to the orchestrator.

Startup-memory limitation: Opus loaded process-only memory index lines, no substantive prior-PR technical memory. No verified no-memory option was used. Preserve native history and disclose this, never delete history or claim a memory-free session. No persistent memory was intentionally edited.

No confirmed Omadev defect, no desktop slot used, no resource request needed, no upstream action. Saved HTML is not opened. Process-only deviations do not invalidate the narrowly supported resolution or confer posting permission.
